Subject: Quick ask — accelerator credits for FluxAI pilot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the latency numbers and the prefix caching example. FluxAI was just accepted into the NeonSpark accelerator and they provide some vendor credits, but we still need partner promotional support to cover inference spend for our first three months of pilot traffic.

High-level ask: would Redwood consider a conditional accelerator credit (pilot promo) of $20k USD to be applied over the first 90 days? We can commit to three things to make this low-risk for you:
- Technical write-up + performance benchmark (shared with Redwood) within 30 days
- Quarterly joint case study should the pilot hit SLA targets
- Introduce Redwood to NeonSpark ops team for marketplace consideration

Attached are a short product one-pager and our accelerator deck — happy to send a more detailed MAP if helpful. Could we get an eligibility check + any standard accelerator promo template you use?

Best,
Alex

Short answer: we can consider a milestone-based promotional credit for accelerator-stage pilots; typical structure is a time-bound credit that vests on delivery of mutually agreed milestones (benchmarks, case study, and marketplace intro). I looped in Monica from Partner Programs to help with the MAP template and eligibility checklist.

1) Monica will share our accelerator promo checklist and a MAP template.

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Alex / Priyom — attaching our accelerator promo checklist and a simple Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template. Quick notes inline:

- Eligibility: early-stage startups in an accelerator are eligible for promotional consideration if they can commit to a performance benchmark and one co-marketing asset.
- Typical promo: $10k–$25k applied as a credit over 60–120 days depending on forecasted usage and product fit.
- Approval path: Partner Programs -> Sales Director approval (Rishi) -> Finance signoff for billing exception.

Attachment: MAP-template.docx (see high-level milestones below)

Suggested MAP (example):
1) Pilot start: day 0 — Redwood provisioned model endpoint, prefix caching enabled.
2) Milestone A (day 30): FluxAI provides performance benchmark report (latency P50/P95, tokens consumed) and a short technical notes doc. Credit release: 40% of promo.
3) Milestone B (day 60): FluxAI publishes a joint blog/case study draft. Credit release: 40% of promo.
4) Milestone C (day 90): Intro made to NeonSpark ops & marketplace contact; adoption playbook shared. Credit release: 20% of promo.

If that aligns with you, Priyom — please send forecast and kick it to Rishi for approval.

— Monica
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP-template.docx

Looping in for approval. Quick read — FluxAI looks like a reasonable fit for a promo in the $15k-$20k range given the accelerator tie-in and clear MAP. A few internal constraints:
- Need a Line of Business (LOB) owner documented in HubSpot before fund release. Priyom, please make sure the opportunity record has the technical contact and expected spend populated.
- Finance flagged that promo credits > $15k require a one-off billing exception ticket; I can sign off contingent on that ticket and a short exec approval email.

Approving in principle for $20k conditional on:
1) Forecasted 90d spend >= $25k (so the promo covers a portion, not entire usage)
2) MAP accepted and signed off by Partner Programs + FluxAI
3) HubSpot opp updated with LOB and technical contact

Priyom — if you can confirm the forecast and nudge Alex for a MAP sign-off, I’ll file the billing exception and send the executive approval.
